desktop.notes: Stages and visits: Masters > Stage master (one list of stages); a service ticks its stages from it; a project gets its services' stages and may add, move or delete them for itself; Calendars > Calendar in the man-day calendar's place — + on a date books a visit (blue planned, amber confirmed, green closed, pink certification audit, red missed); double-click a visit to close it with its stages and its expenses (bill photo, charge to the client). The man-day calendar is the Calendar's Consultants view.
